what: `switchboard score sample` grades the spec's sample rate of finished runs against each scorer and writes rating rows; failed ratings are batched into one proposed change to the spec, opened as a pull request for the owner.
expectations: With sample rate 0.25, about one run in four is scored and each gets one rating row per scorer.
A proposed change is a pull request and raises one Waiting on you item; nothing edits a spec on main directly.
